title: Checkout failing with 'connection pool exhausted' errors
resolution: PgBouncer max_client_conn was 500 and saturated during the holiday sale. Root cause: connection leak in the orders service after release 3.14.2. Fix: rolled back to 3.14.1 and raised max_client_conn to 1000. Follow-up PIR action: add pool-saturation alert.

title: Primary database down in eu-west-1
resolution: orders-db-primary lost its disk. Failover executed using runbook RB-DB-004; standby-1 promoted in 11 minutes. RPO met (no data loss).

title: Some users cannot log in with Okta SSO
resolution: Clock skew on two Okta agent hosts. Fixed by re-enabling NTP sync. Workaround was password + MFA login.

title: Product search returns stale prices
resolution: Elasticsearch index refresh job stuck after a mapping change. Reindexed products-v7 and added a staleness monitor.

title: Password reset emails delayed by 20+ minutes
resolution: SendGrid rate limiting due to marketing campaign sharing the same API key. Proposed fix: separate transactional sub-user.

title: Card payments declined for Amex
resolution: Payment gateway rotated its TLS certificate; our pinning config was outdated. Updated pinned certificates and removed pinning for the gateway domain.

title: Request: access to DataGrip for analytics team
resolution: Approved per software catalogue; licences assigned by IT.

title: Question: does carry-over PTO expire?
resolution: Answered by People Team: under HR-POL-002 v4.0 carried-over days expire on 30 June.
